name: soybean
sowing_season: Kharif: mid-June to mid-July, after about 100 mm of monsoon rain
soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam (black soil is ideal), pH 6.0–7.5; no waterlogging

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.description: Seeds swell and seedlings come up in 4–7 days.
stages.irrigation: Sow only after good monsoon rain (about 100 mm). If the soil dries after sowing, give a light irrigation.
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 50 kg DAP + 25 kg MOP + 8 kg sulphur (or 100 kg gypsum) per acre. Treat seed with Thiram + Carbendazim (2:1) 3 g per kg, then Rhizobium + PSB culture 5 g per kg.
watch_for: Poor germination from old or damaged seed
tips: Do a germination test — sow seed with 70% or more germination
Seed rate 25–30 kg per acre, rows 45 cm apart
Sow on broad beds and furrows (BBF) or ridges to drain extra rain

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Leaves and branches grow; root nodules start fixing nitrogen.
stages.irrigation: Usually rain-fed. Drain standing water within 24 hours.
stages.fertilizer: No urea needed — the root nodules supply nitrogen. If leaves are pale, spray 2% urea (20 g per litre).
watch_for: Girdle beetle — two rings cut around the stem, the top wilts
tips: Keep the field weed-free up to 45 days (weed or hoe at 20 and 40 days)
Cut and destroy plant parts with girdle beetle rings

stages.name: Flowering
stages.description: Purple or white flowers appear. The crop is sensitive to drought now.
stages.irrigation: If there is no rain for 10–12 days, give one protective irrigation.
watch_for: Semilooper and tobacco caterpillar eating leaves
tips: Put up 10 bird perches and 5 pheromone traps per acre
Pull out plants with yellow mosaic early

stages.name: Pod Formation / Pod Filling
stages.description: Pods form and seeds fill. Water stress now cuts yield the most.
stages.irrigation: Give a protective irrigation if a dry spell comes at pod filling.
watch_for: Rust — small brown pustules under leaves
Charcoal rot in hot, dry spells
tips: For caterpillars spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC 0.3 ml/litre
For rust spray Hexaconazole 5 EC 1.5 ml/litre

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
stages.description: Leaves turn yellow and drop; pods turn brown.
watch_for: Pods shattering if harvest is late
Rain damage to the cut crop
tips: Harvest when 95% of pods are brown
Dry the seed to 10% moisture before storing and handle seed meant for sowing gently

common_pests.name: Girdle beetle
common_pests.symptoms: Two parallel rings cut around the stem or branch; the part above wilts
common_pests.control: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC 0.3 ml/litre; remove affected plant parts

common_pests.name: Stem fly
common_pests.symptoms: Zig-zag tunnels inside the stem, young plants dry
common_pests.control: Seed treatment with Thiamethoxam 30 FS 10 ml per kg seed

common_pests.name: Leaf-eating caterpillars (semilooper, tobacco caterpillar)
common_pests.control: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC 0.3 ml/litre; pheromone traps 5 per acre

common_pests.name: Whitefly
common_pests.symptoms: Tiny white flies under leaves; spreads yellow mosaic
common_pests.control: Yellow sticky traps 10 per acre; Thiamethoxam 25 WG 0.2 g/litre

common_diseases.name: Yellow mosaic
common_diseases.symptoms: Bright yellow and green patches on leaves, few pods
common_diseases.control: No cure — pull out infected plants early, control whitefly, sow resistant varieties

common_diseases.name: Rust
common_diseases.symptoms: Small brown-red pustules under leaves, early leaf fall

common_diseases.name: Charcoal rot
common_diseases.symptoms: Plants wilt and dry suddenly in hot, dry weather; grey-black inside the stem base
common_diseases.control: Seed treatment with Trichoderma 5 g per kg; protective irrigation in long dry spells
